macros.name: Blank
macros.doc: \Blank Creates an underline field for student answers.

macros.name: EssayQuestion
macros.doc: \EssayQuestion Defines an essay question (no limit on number of lines).

macros.name: FillQuestion
macros.doc: \FillQuestion Defines a fill-in-the-blank question with its answer.

macros.name: MCOption
macros.doc: \MCOption Defines an option for a multiple-choice question.

macros.name: MCQuestion
macros.doc: \MCQuestion Defines a multiple-choice question within the MC environment.

macros.name: OrderAnswer
macros.doc: \OrderAnswer Adds an optional answer space after ordering options.

macros.name: OrderOption
macros.doc: \OrderOption Defines an option for an ordering question.

macros.name: ShortQuestion
macros.doc: \ShortQuestion Defines a short answer question (0, 1, or 2 lines, capped at 2 without warning).

macros.name: ShowCorrection
macros.doc: Enables the display of correction boxes for teacher use.

macros.name: WordBank
macros.doc: \WordBank Displays a dynamic word bank box.

envs.name: Essay
envs.doc: The Essay environment creates open-ended, long-form written response questions.

envs.name: Matching
envs.doc: The Matching environment creates two-column association questions.

envs.name: MC
envs.doc: The MC environment creates multiple-choice questions with automatically shuffled options.

envs.name: Question
envs.doc: The Question environment is the primary container for all question types.

envs.name: TF
envs.doc: The TF environment creates True/False questions.
